content:
name: Pillow runtime repair CI

# Isolated tests only. No provider credentials, deployments, production requests,
# commerce side effects, Birth certification or Wave-credit changes are permitted.
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - 'fix/pillow-runtime-*'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: pillow-runtime-repair-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.ref || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

env:
  CI: 'true'
  SOAK_ALLOW_LIVE_RUN: '0'
  NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: '1'

jobs:
  locked-railway-package:
    name: Exact-source Railway Railpack image
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # 30m image build + two (180s startup + 720s fault) arms + upload margin.
    timeout-minutes: 65
    steps:
      - name: Checkout candidate source without merge or persisted credentials
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 2
      - name: Use the repository Node pin
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version-file: '.node-version'
      - name: Build the effective root Railway configuration without deployment
        timeout-minutes: 30
        shell: bash
        env:
          BUILDKIT_HOST: docker-container://buildkit
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl --fail --location --retry 3 --max-time 120 \
            https://github.com/railwayapp/railpack/releases/download/v0.40.1/railpack-v0.40.1-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/railpack.tar.gz"
          echo "2842de93e68713af9037e0bc0a398d7da78f3b96aa4804303a638db2bc69bd30  $RUNNER_TEMP/railpack.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check
          mkdir "$RUNNER_TEMP/railpack-bin"
          tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/railpack.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/railpack-bin"
          docker run --rm --privileged -d --name buildkit moby/buildkit:latest
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json, pathlib, tomllib
          config = tomllib.loads(pathlib.Path('railway.toml').read_text())
          assert config['build']['builder'] == 'RAILPACK'
          assert config['build']['railpackVersion'] == '0.40.1'
          assert config['deploy']['startCommand'] == 'node deployment/locked-runtime.cjs'
          assert config['deploy']['numReplicas'] == 1
          assert config['deploy']['healthcheckPath'] == '/health/ready'
          pathlib.Path('/tmp/empire-build-command').write_text(config['build']['buildCommand'])
          pathlib.Path('/tmp/empire-start-command').write_text(config['deploy']['startCommand'])
          PY
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/railpack-bin/railpack" build . --name empireai-locked:ci \
            --build-cmd "export RAILWAY_GIT_COMMIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD) && $(cat /tmp/empire-build-command)" \
            --start-cmd "$(cat /tmp/empire-start-command)" --progress plain
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/locked-package-evidence"
          docker image inspect empireai-locked:ci > "$RUNNER_TEMP/locked-package-evidence/image.json"
          launcher_sha=$(sha256sum deployment/locked-runtime.cjs | cut -d ' ' -f 1)
          docker run --rm --network none -e EXPECTED_REVISION="$(git rev-parse HEAD)" -e EXPECTED_LAUNCHER_SHA="$launcher_sha" --entrypoint node empireai-locked:ci -e '
            const fs = require("node:fs"), assert = require("node:assert/strict"), crypto = require("node:crypto");
            assert.equal(process.versions.node, "22.23.2");
            assert.ok(fs.existsSync("backend/dist/index.js"));
            const {resolveRuntimeRevision} = require("./deployment/runtime-revision.cjs");
            assert.equal(resolveRuntimeRevision(process.cwd(), undefined), process.env.EXPECTED_REVISION);
            assert.throws(() => resolveRuntimeRevision(process.cwd(), "0".repeat(40)), /mismatch/);
            const launcher = crypto.createHash("sha256").update(fs.readFileSync("deployment/locked-runtime.cjs")).digest("hex");
            assert.match(process.env.EXPECTED_LAUNCHER_SHA, /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/);
            assert.equal(launcher, process.env.EXPECTED_LAUNCHER_SHA);
            console.log(JSON.stringify({node: process.versions.node, lockedLauncherSha256: launcher, backendBuilt: true}));
          ' | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/locked-package-evidence/runtime.json"
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json, os, pathlib
          image = json.loads((pathlib.Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP'])/'locked-package-evidence/image.json').read_text())[0]
          assert image['Config']['Cmd'][-1] == 'node deployment/locked-runtime.cjs', image['Config']['Cmd']
          PY
          git rev-parse HEAD > "$RUNNER_TEMP/locked-package-evidence/source-sha.txt"
          cp railway.toml railpack.json "$RUNNER_TEMP/locked-package-evidence/"
          cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/locked-package-evidence/source-sha.txt" "$RUNNER_TEMP/locked-package-evidence/runtime.json" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
      - name: Assess exact accepted-source examination-only reuse boundary
        id: f29-boundary
        run: node scripts/work8/f27-change-boundary.cjs >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Preserve explicitly retained F29 receipt
        if: steps.f29-boundary.outputs.run_f29 == 'false'
        run: node scripts/work8/f27-change-boundary.cjs --receipt f29 "$RUNNER_TEMP/locked-package-evidence/retained-f29.json" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
      - name: Examine F27 simultaneous faults with independent external oracle
        timeout-minutes: 5
        run: |
          node scripts/work8/f27-outer-controller.cjs empireai-locked:ci "$RUNNER_TEMP/f27-external-evidence"
      - name: Preserve F27 external observations and protected containment
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: work8-f27-external-compound
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/f27-external-evidence
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Examine remaining F29 supervision pair loss in isolated exact image
        if: steps.f29-boundary.outputs.run_f29 != 'false'
        timeout-minutes: 32
        run: |
          node scripts/work8/f29-outer-controller.cjs empireai-locked:ci "$RUNNER_TEMP/f29-pair-evidence"
      - name: Preserve owner-visible F29 incident and containment receipts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: work8-f29-pair-containment
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/f29-pair-evidence
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Preserve exact-source packaging receipt
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: locked-railway-package
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/locked-package-evidence
          if-no-files-found: error

  durable-runtime:
    name: Durable runtime — real Redis, restart, ownership and authorization
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      NODE_ENV: test
      PILLOW_TEST_REDIS_SERVER: /usr/bin/redis-server
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact event revision without persisting credentials
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Use Node.js 22 with npm cache
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version-file: '.node-version'
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: |
            pillow/package-lock.json
            backend/package-lock.json
      - name: Require offline certification, redeploy and collection evidence tests
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Synthetic rejection tests only; no hosted proof or certification credit.
          env -i PATH="$PATH" HOME="$RUNNER_TEMP" TMPDIR="$RUNNER_TEMP" \
            CI=true NODE_ENV=test SOAK_ALLOW_LIVE_RUN=0 \
            node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=tap \
            scripts/evaluate-certification-evidence.test.mjs \
            scripts/certification-harnesses/canary-redeploy.test.mjs \
            scripts/collect-economics-held-cases.test.mjs \
            | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/pillow-certification-evidence-tests.tap"
          node --input-type=module - "$RUNNER_TEMP/pillow-certification-evidence-tests.tap" <<'NODE'
          import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
          import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
          const output = readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8');
          const count = (name) => {
            const match = output.match(new RegExp(`^# ${name} (\\d+)$`, 'm'));
            assert.ok(match, `Missing evidence-test TAP summary: ${name}`);
            return Number(match[1]);
          };
          assert.ok(count('tests') >= 42, 'All three offline evidence suites must execute');
          assert.equal(count('pass'), count('tests'), 'Every evidence rejection test must pass');
          for (const kind of ['fail', 'cancelled', 'skipped', 'todo']) {
            assert.equal(count(kind), 0, `${kind} evidence tests are not permitted`);
          }
          NODE
      - name: Install Redis binary for test-owned isolated AOF processes
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install --yes redis-server
          test -x "$PILLOW_TEST_REDIS_SERVER"
          "$PILLOW_TEST_REDIS_SERVER" --version
          # The mandatory integration suite owns its loopback port, data directory,
          # AOF persistence and process restarts. No hosted Redis credentials are used.
      - name: Clean install, typecheck and build Pillow
        run: |
          npm ci --prefix pillow
          npm run typecheck --prefix pillow
          npm run build --prefix pillow
      - name: Run mandatory Pillow observer and reasoning-only policy tests
        working-directory: pillow
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=tap \
            src/validation/tests/observer-runtime-policy.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/reasoning-only-completion.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/read-only-reasoning-admission.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/mission-runtime-persistence.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/mission-execution-truth.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/mission-runtime-sqlite.test.ts \
            | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/pillow-reasoning-policy-tests.tap"
          node --input-type=module - "$RUNNER_TEMP/pillow-reasoning-policy-tests.tap" <<'NODE'
          import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
          import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
          const output = readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8');
          const count = (name) => {
            const match = output.match(new RegExp(`^# ${name} (\\d+)$`, 'm'));
            assert.ok(match, `Missing TAP summary: ${name}`);
            return Number(match[1]);
          };
          assert.ok(count('tests') > 0, 'Pillow policy tests must actually execute');
          assert.equal(count('pass'), count('tests'), 'Every Pillow policy test must pass');
          for (const kind of ['fail', 'cancelled', 'skipped', 'todo']) {
            assert.equal(count(kind), 0, `${kind} tests are not permitted`);
          }
          NODE
      - name: Clean install, verify, typecheck and build backend
        run: |
          npm ci --prefix backend
          npm run verify:env --prefix backend
          npm run typecheck --prefix backend
          npm run build --prefix backend
      - name: Verify changed examination boundaries
        run: |
          node --test scripts/work8/tests/f27-change-boundary.test.cjs scripts/work8/tests/f27-clock-origin.test.cjs
          node --experimental-vm-modules scripts/work8/tests/hh3-owned-process-group.test.mjs
      # Insert into durable-runtime immediately after backend build; not the F29 job.
      # Exact held app/helper + HH3 scripts must be present in this candidate revision.
      - name: Build compiled coordinator examination image
        timeout-minutes: 10
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -f backend/dist/runtime/work8-generated-capture-hold.js
          docker build --file scripts/work8/hh3.Dockerfile --tag work8-hh3:ci .
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/hh3-evidence"
          chmod 0777 "$RUNNER_TEMP/hh3-evidence"
          docker image inspect work8-hh3:ci > "$RUNNER_TEMP/hh3-evidence/image.json"
          git rev-parse HEAD > "$RUNNER_TEMP/hh3-evidence/source-sha.txt"
      - name: Examine actual compiled coordinator timeout and error paths
        timeout-minutes: 9
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          container="work8-hh3-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}"
          trap 'docker rm --force "$container" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
          docker create --name "$container" --read-only --network none \
            --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --pids-limit 256 \
            --memory 5g --cpus 2 --tmpfs /tmp:rw,nosuid,nodev,size=2g \
            --mount "type=bind,source=$RUNNER_TEMP/hh3-evidence,target=/evidence" \
            -e NODE_ENV=test -e EMPIRE_ENGINEERING_TEST_MODE=true \
            -e HH3_SOURCE="$(git rev-parse HEAD)" work8-hh3:ci
          docker inspect "$container" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/hh3-evidence/container-before.json"
          timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10s 480s docker start --attach "$container"
          docker inspect "$container" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/hh3-evidence/container-after.json"
          test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.ExitCode}}' "$container")" = 0
          test -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/hh3-evidence/timeout/receipt.json"
          test -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/hh3-evidence/observer-error/receipt.json"
          test -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/hh3-evidence/invalidate-error/receipt.json"
      - name: Preserve compiled coordinator examination receipts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: work8-hh3-compiled-coordinator
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/hh3-evidence
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Examine generated application held capture and external containment
        timeout-minutes: 5
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/hh4-evidence"
          image_id=$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' work8-hh3:ci)
          node --test scripts/work8/hh4-held-capture-controller.test.mjs
          node scripts/work8/hh4-held-capture-controller.mjs "$image_id" "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" "$RUNNER_TEMP/hh4-evidence"
          node --test scripts/work8/hh4-inspection-restoration.test.mjs
          node --input-type=module - "$RUNNER_TEMP/hh4-evidence" "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" <<'NODE'
          import fs from 'node:fs';
          import path from 'node:path';
          import {examineInspectionRestoration} from './scripts/work8/hh4-inspection-restoration.mjs';
          const [root,source]=process.argv.slice(2);
          const held=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,'container-evidence/hh4-held.json'),'utf8'));
          examineInspectionRestoration({directory:path.join(root,'container-evidence/held-capture'),digest:held.digest,source,destination:path.join(root,'fresh-inspection-restoration')});
          NODE
          # Reuse the same exact compiled image; never boot the historical archive.
          docker run --rm --interactive --read-only --network none \
            --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" \
            --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --pids-limit 64 \
            --memory 1g --cpus 1 --tmpfs /tmp:rw,nosuid,nodev,size=512m \
            --mount "type=bind,source=$RUNNER_TEMP/hh4-evidence,target=/evidence,readonly" \
            --entrypoint node "$image_id" --input-type=module - "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" \
            > "$RUNNER_TEMP/hh4-evidence/domain-rehydration-result.json" <<'NODE'
          import fs from 'node:fs';
          import {examineDomainRehydration} from './scripts/work8/hh4-domain-rehydration.mjs';
          const source=process.argv[2];
          const held=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/evidence/container-evidence/hh4-held.json','utf8'));
          const ready=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/evidence/container-evidence/hh4-worker-ready.json','utf8'));
          const result=await examineDomainRehydration({repo:'/app',directory:'/evidence/container-evidence/held-capture',digest:held.digest,source,inventory:ready.inventory});
          console.log(JSON.stringify(result,null,2));
          NODE
      - name: Preserve actual generated application startup and held capture evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: work8-hh4-held-capture
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/hh4-evidence
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Verify bounded multi-provider inference and preserved authority
        run: node --import ./backend/node_modules/tsx/dist/loader.mjs --test backend/src/validation/tests/advisor-gateway.test.ts backend/src/validation/tests/advisor-pillow-readback.test.ts backend/src/validation/tests/provider-receipt-readback.test.ts backend/src/validation/tests/answer-gate-diagnostics.test.ts backend/src/validation/tests/owner-commissioning-readback.test.ts backend/src/validation/tests/locked-inference.test.ts backend/src/validation/tests/locked-provider-orchestration.test.ts backend/src/validation/tests/locked-reasoning-integration.test.ts
      - name: Verify response completion and frontend preservation safeguards
        run: node --import ./backend/node_modules/tsx/dist/loader.mjs --test backend/src/validation/tests/executive-response-completion.test.ts empireai-web/lib/pillow/confirmed-reasoning.test.ts empireai-web/lib/pillow/durable-delivery.test.ts empireai-web/lib/pillow/bff-chat-sanitize.test.ts
      - name: Prove permanent locked runtime and complete enabled-store restore
        env:
          PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          sudo install -d -m 700 -o "$(id -un)" /data
          node --test deployment/locked-runtime.test.cjs
          node deployment/precutover-closure.cjs
      - name: Retain pre-cutover closure evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: precutover-closure
          path: precutover-evidence/
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Run mandatory isolated runtime and session tests
        working-directory: backend
        shell: bash
        env:
          # Legacy offline auth fixtures deliberately use a local memory session.
          # The real-Redis suite explicitly requires production durability and
          # proves that production still refuses this fallback permission.
          REDIS_OPTIONAL: 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=tap \
            src/validation/tests/locked-commissioning.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/work3-institutional-memory.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/work4-intelligence.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/work1-reconstructed.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/pillow-investigation.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/pillow-durable-queue-redis.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/capture-shared-brain-redis.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/pillow-durable-reasoning-worker.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/pillow-durable-access.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/mission-runtime-access.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/amazon-publish-authority.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/pillow-authority-contract.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/amazon-listing-proof.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/mission-execution-binding.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/mission-execution-durability.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/mission-authority-wiring.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/strategic-memory-read-preservation.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/strategic-memory-engine.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/certification-receipt-intake.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/held-case-budget-ledger.test.ts \
            src/runtime/held-case-dispatch.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/offline-state-bundle.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/reasoning-only-policy.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/session-store-unavailable.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/work8-generated-startup-protocol.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/work8-product-history.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/locked-fresh-session.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/sqlite-persistence-boundary.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/sqlite-shutdown-boundary.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/primary-shutdown.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/continuity-heartbeat-clock.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/executive-continuity-watchdog.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/independent-shutdown-last-attempt.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/sqlite-corruption-recovery.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/shadow-ceo-durability.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/engineering-test-mode.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/cost-guard-authorization.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/llm-call-control.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/llm-provider-cancellation.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/auth-readiness.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/auth-verification.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/bootstrap-credential-policy.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/bootstrap-password-sync.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/pillow-durable-delivery-fault-matrix.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/tier0-isolated-primary.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/worker-http-proxy.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/exec-cap-authority-compact.lock.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/commerce-reasoning-admission.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/durable-pending-receipt.lock.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/pillow-terminal-json.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/pillow-chat-request-store.test.ts \
            src/validation/tests/pillow-accepted-request-recovery.test.ts \
            | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/pillow-runtime-tests.tap"
          node --input-type=module - "$RUNNER_TEMP/pillow-runtime-tests.tap" <<'NODE'
          import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
          import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
          const output = readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8');
          const count = (name) => {
            const match = output.match(new RegExp(`^# ${name} (\\d+)$`, 'm'));
            assert.ok(match, `Missing TAP summary: ${name}`);
            return Number(match[1]);
          };
          // All six ledger cases must execute; aggregate counts cannot hide a removed suite.
          for (const name of [
            'campaign identity/cap/expiry are immutable and malformed money cannot authorize',
            'foreign databases are refused without replacing their records',
            'timeouts, retry IDs and restart retain reservations; duplicate IDs never redispatch',
            'only final receipt releases unused reservation; conflicting settlement and overruns are visible',
            'expired campaign cannot reserve even with remaining balance but final reconciliation remains possible',
            'independent processes cannot reserve the same funds twice; committed reservation survives exit without close',
          ]) {
            assert.ok(output.split(/\r?\n/).some(line => /^ok \d+ - /.test(line) && line.endsWith(` - ${name}`)),
              `Missing mandatory executed ledger test: ${name}`);
          }
          assert.ok(count('tests') > 0, 'Runtime tests must actually execute');
          for (const name of [
            'unconfigured or denied trusted verifier cannot dispatch; client permission fields are forbidden',
            'success retains full reservation; duplicate request and reopen never redispatch',
            'timeout aborts one attempt and preserves uncertain full hold without retry',
            'provider/model mismatch, tools, fallback and prompt mutation are rejected before dispatch',
            'missing/expired pricing or unknown other costs cannot reserve or dispatch',
            'independent ledger connections racing distinct steps cannot overspend campaign cap',
            'provider response violation retains hold and a policy revision cannot reset prior spend',
            'actual scope, output bound, expiry and pre-aborted calls fail before dispatch',
            'retained verifier references and mutable originals cannot change the approved dispatch snapshot',
          ]) {
            assert.ok(output.split(/\r?\n/).some(line => /^ok \d+ - /.test(line) && line.endsWith(` - ${name}`)),
              `Missing mandatory executed held dispatch test: ${name}`);
          }
          for (const name of [
            'timeouts are finite integer bounded and reject malformed configuration',
            'deadline aborts the actual in-flight fake provider once',
            'already cancelled caller cannot invoke provider; caller cancellation propagates',
            'fast success clears timer and provider errors are never retried',
            'a noncooperative provider remains bounded locally without claiming remote cancellation',
            'openai real SDK receives per-request maxRetries zero and performs one fake fetch on 503',
            'openai actual SDK fake fetch sees timeout abort',
            'anthropic real SDK receives per-request maxRetries zero and performs one fake fetch on 503',
            'anthropic actual SDK fake fetch sees timeout abort',
            'Gemini adapter forwards cancellation and rejects already-aborted work before client acquisition',
            'Gemini installed SDK propagates signal into its actual fetch transport',
            'router aborts its actual provider invocation on timeout without retry',
            'invalid router timeout fails before provider resolution',
          ]) {
            assert.ok(output.split(/\r?\n/).some(line => /^\s*ok \d+ - /.test(line) && line.endsWith(` - ${name}`)),
              `Missing mandatory executed cancellation test: ${name}`);
          }
          assert.equal(count('pass'), count('tests'), 'Every runtime test must pass');
          for (const kind of ['fail', 'cancelled', 'skipped', 'todo']) {
            assert.equal(count(kind), 0, `${kind} tests are not permitted`);
          }
          NODE
      - name: Record exact tested revision and scope
        env:
          PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          {
            echo '## Durable runtime repair gate'
            echo "Exact tested checkout: $(git rev-parse HEAD)"
            echo "PR head: ${PR_HEAD_SHA:-not a pull request}"
            echo "Node: $(node --version)"
            "$PILLOW_TEST_REDIS_SERVER" --version
            echo 'Isolated real-Redis AOF/restart, duplicate delivery, authorization and recovery tests passed with zero skipped tests.'
            echo 'No deployment, live commerce, independent Birth certification or production readiness is claimed.'
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  generated-full-path:
    # The two complete intercepted-provider corpora previously consumed ~25 minutes
    # before the runtime/session suite could start. Give each its own bounded job;
    # every corpus and the runtime suite remain mandatory in the final gate.
    name: Generated full path — ${{ matrix.corpus }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        corpus: [reasoning-admission, response-delivery]
    env:
      NODE_ENV: test
      PILLOW_TEST_REDIS_SERVER: /usr/bin/redis-server
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact event revision without persisting credentials
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 2
      - name: Assess accepted corpus reuse at exact unchanged runtime boundary
        id: corpus-boundary
        run: node scripts/work8/f27-change-boundary.cjs >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Record retained corpus evidence without claiming new execution
        if: steps.corpus-boundary.outputs.run_corpora == 'false'
        env:
          CORPUS: ${{ matrix.corpus }}
        run: node scripts/work8/f27-change-boundary.cjs --receipt "$CORPUS" "$RUNNER_TEMP/$CORPUS-retained.json" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
      - name: Use Node.js 22 with npm cache
        if: steps.corpus-boundary.outputs.run_corpora != 'false'
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version-file: '.node-version'
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: |
            pillow/package-lock.json
            backend/package-lock.json
      - name: Install Redis binary for test-owned isolated AOF processes
        if: steps.corpus-boundary.outputs.run_corpora != 'false'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install --yes redis-server
          test -x "$PILLOW_TEST_REDIS_SERVER"
          "$PILLOW_TEST_REDIS_SERVER" --version
          # The mandatory integration suite owns its loopback port, data directory,
          # AOF persistence and process restarts. No hosted Redis credentials are used.
      - name: Clean install, typecheck and build Pillow
        if: steps.corpus-boundary.outputs.run_corpora != 'false'
        run: |
          npm ci --prefix pillow
          npm run typecheck --prefix pillow
          npm run build --prefix pillow
      - name: Clean install, verify, typecheck and build backend
        if: steps.corpus-boundary.outputs.run_corpora != 'false'
        run: |
          npm ci --prefix backend
          npm run verify:env --prefix backend
          npm run typecheck --prefix backend
          npm run build --prefix backend
      - name: Verify complete generated corpus with intercepted provider HTTP
        if: steps.corpus-boundary.outputs.run_corpora != 'false'
        env:
          CORPUS: ${{ matrix.corpus }}
        run: node --import ./backend/node_modules/tsx/dist/loader.mjs "backend/scripts/$CORPUS-full-path.mjs" "$RUNNER_TEMP/$CORPUS-full-path.json"
      - name: Record current checkout identity separately from retained tested source
        if: always()
        env:
          CORPUS: ${{ matrix.corpus }}
        run: git rev-parse HEAD > "$RUNNER_TEMP/$CORPUS-source-sha.txt"
      - name: Upload generated full-path evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: generated-full-path-${{ matrix.corpus }}
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/${{ matrix.corpus }}-full-path.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/${{ matrix.corpus }}-source-sha.txt
            ${{ runner.temp }}/${{ matrix.corpus }}-retained.json
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: error

  durable-web:
    name: Durable web — receipt recovery, one submission, tests and build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact event revision without persisting credentials
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Use Node.js 22 with npm cache
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version-file: '.node-version'
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: empireai-web/package-lock.json
      - name: Clean install and typecheck canonical Next.js web
        run: |
          npm ci --prefix empireai-web
          npm run typecheck --prefix empireai-web
      - name: Run web tests with mandatory durable-delivery coverage
        working-directory: empireai-web
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -f lib/pillow/durable-delivery.test.ts
          test -f lib/pillow/bff-chat-sanitize.test.ts
          node --import tsx --test --test-reporter=tap 'lib/**/*.test.ts' \
            | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/pillow-web-tests.tap"
          node --input-type=module - "$RUNNER_TEMP/pillow-web-tests.tap" <<'NODE'
          import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
          import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
          const output = readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8');
          const count = (name) => {
            const match = output.match(new RegExp(`^# ${name} (\\d+)$`, 'm'));
            assert.ok(match, `Missing TAP summary: ${name}`);
            return Number(match[1]);
          };
          assert.ok(count('tests') > 0, 'Web tests must actually execute');
          assert.equal(count('pass'), count('tests'), 'Every web test must pass');
          for (const kind of ['fail', 'cancelled', 'skipped', 'todo']) {
            assert.equal(count(kind), 0, `${kind} tests are not permitted`);
          }
          NODE
      - name: Build canonical Next.js web
        run: npm run build --prefix empireai-web
      - name: Record exact tested revision and scope
        env:
          PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          {
            echo '## Durable web repair gate'
            echo "Exact tested checkout: $(git rev-parse HEAD)"
            echo "PR head: ${PR_HEAD_SHA:-not a pull request}"
            echo 'Existing web tests plus mandatory durable-delivery and BFF coverage passed with zero skipped tests.'
            echo 'This is mocked-transport web coverage and a production build, not a live authenticated browser certification.'
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  runtime-repair-result:
    name: Runtime repair result (no deployment)
    if: ${{ always() }}
    needs: [durable-runtime, durable-web, locked-railway-package, generated-full-path]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Require every mandatory repair gate to pass
        env:
          GENERATED_RESULT: ${{ needs.generated-full-path.result }}
          RUNTIME_RESULT: ${{ needs.durable-runtime.result }}
          WEB_RESULT: ${{ needs.durable-web.result }}
          PACKAGE_RESULT: ${{ needs.locked-railway-package.result }}
        run: |
          test "$GENERATED_RESULT" = success
          test "$RUNTIME_RESULT" = success
          test "$WEB_RESULT" = success
          test "$PACKAGE_RESULT" = success
          echo 'Runtime and web repair checks passed. No production promotion or commerce unlock is authorized by this result.' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
